title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
one_line_judgement: 值得继续观察：据摘要（arXiv 2610.26844）：AnyGoal 盯住世界模型的一个具体失效面——'for these uses to be re…
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26844）：AnyGoal 盯住世界模型的一个具体失效面——'for these uses to be reliable, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts'，并用 compositional generalization 作为切入口：'can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics?'。benchmark 设计克制：每个任务 'within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics'，只是 'their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories'。结论是负面且重要的一类：'current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations'。这直接约束我们自己的 world-model / planner 选型——训练分布内跑得好不等于换个目标还能用。摘要提到 'together with an open-source library'，但未给出 URL，暂无可核验链接（待核验/暂无）。今日动作：给内部 world-model 评测加一组 goal-shift 变体，而不是只测训练分布内任务。
